loading: copy unchanged pinned configuration/modeling into isolated local package; direct NewConfig/NewForSequenceClassification import, no AutoModel/remote loading; local safetensors load_file and strict load_state_dict; all hashes verified before custom imports

remaining_gate: implement exact loader/probe and independent code review before model execution; current review is runtime readiness only
